standalone_sources.provenance: Original standalone Git blob; this source is not a file in the release tree.

closure.scope: Complete selected fleet/recovery/deploy/delivery/pilot/SDK components, followed by their actual local imports and declared runtime assets at this same release. Broader provider modules reached through the selected catalogs are retained as source; their inclusion does not assert that every provider is configured or its optional external package installed.
closure.host_selected_modules: Playwright, configured signer/handler/provider modules and receiving runtime paths remain explicit original host inputs. This source index does not provision them.

receiving.parts_format: Each exact UTF-8 JSON part is {files:[{path,content}]}. Verify its bytes and SHA-256 before parsing; require its ordered path membership to equal parts[].files. Require disjoint union equality with manifest.files, verify every original Git blob and SHA-256, and hydrate the canonical repository-relative paths with the declared mode.
receiving.execution_state: Source assembled and verified; no product case or native execution is represented by this source index.
